explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full slack system, prioritizing the primary pricing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The Slack clone site delivers a clear pricing flow and dynamic feature filtering, but suffers from pervasive mobile usability issues and broken deep-link navigation. Critical tap targets across headers, footers, and toggles fall well below the 44px minimum, making mobile interaction frustrating. Additionally, deep links to feature sections fail to scroll, and form validation is missing, creating significant friction for users on conversion paths.

exploration_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Slack system, prioritizing the primary pricing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_plan.summary: The exploration will start by deeply analyzing the primary pricing page, including toggling billing periods and validating feature comparisons. It will then traverse the adjacent acquisition flows (Get Started, Sign In, Contact Sales) to test form validations and state changes. Next, it will validate the core marketing pages (Features, Solutions, Enterprise, Trust) and their deep links. Finally, the run will repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to assess responsiveness and tap target issues identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The yearly/monthly toggle on pricing.html dynamically updates the prices and feature details without a full page reload.
The contact form and sign-in forms have client-side validation that can be triggered by submitting empty or invalid data.
Deep links with hashes (e.g., features.html#channels) correctly scroll to or highlight the relevant section on the target page.
The 'Get started free' buttons across the site consistently route to the get-started.html page.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: Billing toggle (Monthly/Annual) and feature comparison table layout on smaller screens
contact.html: Form validation, required field handling, and submission state
signin.html: Password recovery flow and error messaging for invalid credentials
index.html: Small tap targets for footer and inline links (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels') on mobile

key_checks: Toggle between Monthly and Annual billing and verify price updates

Verify 'Get started free' and 'Contact sales' buttons for each plan
Check FAQ section expand/collapse behavior
exit_criteria: Feature comparison table is fully expanded and filtered
All plan CTA buttons are clicked and verified

phases.title: Acquisition & Auth Flows
phases.objective: Test the signup, signin, and sales contact forms for validation, state changes, and recovery paths.
key_checks: Submit get-started.html with empty email to trigger validation
Submit signin.html with invalid credentials to observe error state
Click 'Forgot your password?' and verify the reset UI appears
Fill out and submit the contact.html form, checking required field validation and the success state ('Thank you!' heading)
exit_criteria: Form validation errors are triggered on all three forms
Contact form success state is observed

phases.objective: Validate navigation, deep links, and content rendering on feature and solution pages.
key_checks: Click deep links from index.html (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels', 'Explore AI in Slack') and verify scroll/navigation on features.html
Verify features.html internal tab navigation (Collaboration, Project Management, Integrations, Intelligence)

Verify enterprise.html CTA navigation and content layout
exit_criteria: All index.html deep links successfully navigate to the correct section
Features page tabs switch content correctly
Solutions page links are clicked and verified

phases.title: Supporting Pages & Trust

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness Check
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical flows and layout on a mobile viewport, addressing prescan tap target warnings.
key_checks: Verify mobile navigation menu (hamburger) opens and closes on index.html
Check pricing.html table layout and billing toggle on mobile
Validate get-started.html form inputs and social login buttons on mobile
Assess tap target sizes for footer links and inline text links
exit_criteria: Pricing comparison is readable and toggleable on mobile
Signup form is usable on mobile

coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible toggles, form submissions, deep link navigations, and tab filters
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks on mobile viewport, specifically targeting known small tap targets and form layouts

notes: Prescan flagged multiple small tap targets (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels' at 200x18px). Pay close attention to these during the mobile phase.
The contact form has a hidden 'Thank you!' heading which implies a client-side success state; ensure the form is filled out completely to trigger this.
The signin page has a hidden 'Reset your password' heading, indicating a client-side toggle for the forgot password flow.

findings.user_goal: Navigate the site on a mobile device
findings.problem: Footer navigation links have a tap target height of only 21px, which is less than half the recommended 44px minimum for mobile touch interactions.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings consistently flag footer links (e.g., Features, Enterprise, Pricing, Engineering) as 155x21px across mobile viewports on about.html and resources.html.
findings.why_it_matters: Undersized tap targets force users to pinch-to-zoom or lead to accidental mis-taps, causing frustration and navigation errors for mobile users.
findings.suggestion: Increase the vertical padding of footer links to achieve a minimum tap target height of 44px, ensuring comfortable touch interaction.

findings.user_goal: Quickly access specific feature sections via deep links
findings.problem: Deep links containing hash anchors (e.g., features.html#ai) update the URL but fail to scroll the viewport to the corresponding section, leaving users stranded at the top of the page.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Explore AI in Slack' from index.html navigated to features.html#ai, but the 'Intelligence' tab remained off-screen at a negative Y coordinate (-1850.0).
findings.why_it_matters: Users expect deep links to jump directly to the relevant content. When the page doesn't scroll, users assume the link is broken or the content is missing, breaking trust and increasing cognitive load.
findings.suggestion: Implement JavaScript or CSS scroll-behavior to automatically scroll to the anchored section upon page load when a hash fragment is present in the URL.

findings.user_goal: Sign up with a valid email address
findings.problem: The 'Work email' input on the Get Started page lacks client-side validation, allowing invalid formats (e.g., 'invalid-email') to be submitted without any error feedback.
findings.evidence: Typing 'invalid-email' and pressing Enter into the 'Work email' input did not trigger any visible client-side validation error message, despite the input type being 'email'.
findings.why_it_matters: Without immediate feedback on malformed input, users may be left confused about why subsequent steps fail or why they aren't receiving confirmation emails, leading to drop-offs.
findings.suggestion: Implement inline client-side validation to check for proper email formatting on submit or blur, displaying a clear error message near the input field.

findings.problem: The Monthly/Annual billing toggle on the pricing page has a tap target of 44x24px, failing the 44px minimum height guideline for mobile devices.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings flag the 'Toggle billing period' button (ux-9) as 44x24px on the mobile viewport of pricing.html.
findings.why_it_matters: A 24px height is extremely difficult to tap accurately on a touch screen, potentially preventing users from switching between monthly and annual pricing, which is a critical conversion action.
findings.suggestion: Increase the vertical padding and overall height of the billing toggle to at least 44px to ensure it is easily tappable on mobile devices.

findings.problem: The hamburger menu toggle button on mobile has a tap target of 32x24px, severely undersized for touch interaction.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings on resources.html and about.html flag the 'Toggle menu' button (ux-4) as 32x24px.
findings.why_it_matters: If users cannot easily open the navigation menu, they are effectively blocked from accessing the rest of the site on mobile, severely impacting goal completion.
findings.suggestion: Increase the tap area of the hamburger menu to at least 44x44px by adding padding around the icon.

findings.user_goal: Filter features by category on mobile
findings.problem: Clicking the 'Intelligence' tab on the features page does not update the visible content or scroll to the section, rendering the tab navigation broken on mobile.
findings.evidence: Clicking the 'Intelligence' tab (ux-8) on features.html resulted in 'No obvious URL or visible-text change', and the page remained stuck on the 'Collaboration' section.
findings.why_it_matters: Users rely on category tabs to quickly find specific features. A non-functional tab creates confusion and prevents users from evaluating the product's capabilities.
findings.suggestion: Ensure tab clicks trigger both a visual active state and a scroll action to the corresponding content section, or dynamically filter the visible content as done on the pricing page.

findings.problem: All resource cards (Help Centre, What's New, Developers, etc.) link back to the same resources.html page instead of dedicated sub-pages.
findings.evidence: DOM interactables for resource cards (ux-5 to ux-10) all show href='resources.html'.
findings.why_it_matters: Clicking a resource card and landing on the same page creates a dead-end experience, failing user expectations of finding specific, deep content like API documentation or blog posts.
findings.suggestion: Link each resource card to its respective dedicated page or a distinct anchor section to provide meaningful navigation.

findings.user_goal: Agree to privacy policy on the contact form
findings.problem: The 'I agree to receive communications' checkbox has a tiny tap target of 13x13px, making it nearly impossible to accurately toggle on a mobile device.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings flag the checkbox (13x13px) and the adjacent 'Privacy Policy' link (72x15px) as severely undersized on the contact page.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may become frustrated trying to check the box, or accidentally tap the privacy link instead, hindering form completion.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the checkbox in a larger invisible clickable label area to expand the tap target to at least 44x44px.
